profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary:
Jaina Morgan is currently a software engineer at JGMS supporting a contract for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration with the National Weather Service. She has a diverse background in project management, large data sets, performance/scalability improvement, and full-stack web development. She works on the Total Operational Weather Readiness - Satellites (TOWR-S) team as the primary engineer responsible for the Satellite Product Analysis and Distribution Enterprise System (SPADES), which delivers space weather products to the Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC). With roles ranging from start-up to government, experienced in working on and with teams of various sizes and technical expertise.

Prior to this, she was an educator for Chegg's Thinkful Web Development bootcamp, which included material on JavaScript, React, Node.js, and basic data structures and algorithms. She also worked on maintaining the curriculum for almost 4 years, most of which were leading the team. She started these roles at Bloc which was acquired by Thinkful and then Chegg. Before that, she did some Ruby-on-Rails work for Scribl.com, a website for self-publishing ebooks and audiobooks with a unique pricing mechanism, and was a software engineer at Lime Brokerage as a developer for their back office applications.  Always eager to learn new things, she had to constantly expand her knowledge about the ever-changing high-speed trading industry.  Since Lime Brokerage works with large data sets, her team was constantly working on ways increase scalability and performance in their applications.  She is also interested in software engineering as a tool to assist in different aspects of society, like finance (at Lime Brokerage), and healthcare (South Boston Community Health Center), and loves mission-driven work like her current position contracting for the NWS. Always interested in bioinformatics, she completed an MITx workshop on Quantitative Biology where she worked with MATLAB, R, and Python to earn her certificate to further her learning while accommodating a caretaking schedule.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
NOAA/NWS Contract
Ongoing duties include: 
- continued support for SPADES (Python, RabbitMQ)
- assisting instrument scientists and scientific software engineers with data validation
- working with the Advanced Weather Interactive Processing System (AWIPS) to increase understanding and efficiency within the TOWR-S team to aid end users

Currently working with pixi and Docker to build a core package, containerize SPADES microservices, and create a GitLab CI/CD pipeline

Preparing SPADES microservices for cloud readiness by de-coupling messaging and storage operations in order to flexibly run the application either on-premises or in the cloud

Refactored AWIPS plugin (Java) intended to flexibly display sparse data; solved N+1 query problem causing major performance issues

Mitigated the effects of a third party memory leak by compiling custom Conda packages with patched libraries, reducing the impact by 90%

Performed analysis on AWIPS’s largest database table, optimized indexes, speeding up operations up to 90 fold

Improved robustness and provided a new interface to process inbound data from the Product Distribution and Access (PDA) for SPADES ingestion service

Participated in three releases for SPADES, including support for two satellite deployments, several new satellite products, and fully functional PDA feed
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Java · RabbitMQ · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Technical Expert - Software Engineering
positions.description:
Chegg acquired Thinkful in September of 2019.

Mentored for Thinkful’s Web Development Curriculum (PERN Stack and Data Structures and Algorithms).

positions.title: Curriculum Maintenance Lead
positions.description:
Worked to improve Thinkful's curriculum by fixing errors, bugs, and keeping the technology up to date.

Reduced the number of tickets by almost 50%.

This position was terminated in October 2021 due to restructuring of the company.

positions.title: Java TA
positions.description: TA'ed for a Java program for Chegg's short term partnership with CapGemini for students who wished to participate.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description: Thinkful acquired Bloc in April 2018.

positions.title: Curriculum Maintenance Lead
positions.description:
Led the team for curriculum improvement.

Improved student satisfaction rate on Bloc's curriculum up to 42%.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Scribl is a website for self-publishing audiobooks.

* Implemented full stack (RoR with Goliath API server) of feature to publish books to third-party sites; this allowed immediate monetization of Scribl.com, which reached over $1,000 of revenue per month within a year of feature launch
* Modified and improved Go book cover generator and connected it to Goliath server
* Implemented extended SoX mp3 verifications for audiobooks, reducing publishing time for authors by providing instant feedback when mp3s do not meet requirements
* Provided regular updates and bug fixes to the site
* Performed minor sysadmin duties via AWS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on Java back-office applications, including variety of critical compliance and accounting reports, start-of-day processing, and end-of-day processing.
* Performed maintenance and updates as necessary to existing reports and daily tasks to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Wrote service within Lime’s Portal (web infrastructure) to communicate with switches via SNMP
* Co-led project to develop JRuby-based automated configuration generator, working with Redmine API, to reduce human error and improve on-boarding of accounts.
* Transitioned all start-of-day processing to Wedbush upon acquisition to ensure day one readiness. Included all critical functions required by clients for trading, e.g., each client needs proper buying power.
* Wrote several reports in Java from scratch to automate tedious accounting tasks to increase efficiency and revenue, such as fee reconciliation for tiered-fee customers and per message billing to recoup costs for port usage on certain exchanges.

positions.title: Logician/Database Analyst
positions.description: Planned and led monthly user group meetings; created complex reports on diabetes and childhood immunizations to benefit the patients and help the health center to track accountability and secure funding.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Served as project manager on PHProjekt, a PHP open-source suite; programmed a script using LDAP that adds users to Unix when created in Windows.  Assisted in regular technical support duties around the health center.
